capabilities.title: Scoped principal capabilities
capabilities.behavior: Authorizes reads and writes by principal, owner, project, optional workspace, operation, resource, and expiry at protocol and transaction boundaries.
acceptance: Workspace sharing cannot grant foreign writes.
Revoked or expired capabilities leave durable state unchanged.

capabilities.title: Bounded background-worker authority
capabilities.behavior: Issues expiring job capabilities for enumerated records and operations without any blanket cross-project write power.
acceptance: Workers cannot broaden scope or mint capabilities.
Cross-project consolidation requires a destination-owner decision.

capabilities.title: Encrypted authenticated protocol
capabilities.behavior: Uses TLS 1.3 mutual authentication, scoped short-lived authorization, replay protection, and explicit remote enrollment.
acceptance: Captured transports contain no plaintext application data.
Invalid peers and replays are rejected before durable intent creation.

capabilities.title: Client compatibility fencing
capabilities.behavior: Negotiates schema and feature ranges and rejects incompatible clients before mutation without downgrade.
acceptance: Both supported range boundaries connect.
Clients outside the range receive a stable incompatibility code and cause zero writes.

capabilities.title: Sandboxed MCP and stdio effects
capabilities.behavior: Runs integrations with explicit resource grants and preserves not_started, committed, and unknown effect states through interruption.
acceptance: Sandboxed processes cannot reach ungranted files, network, credentials, or daemon storage.
Unknown effects are never labeled failed or automatically retried.

capabilities.title: Egress and secret containment
capabilities.behavior: Applies destination checks before and after DNS, redirect, and proxy resolution while keeping secrets behind opaque dispatch-time handles.
acceptance: Rebinding, mixed DNS, metadata, redirect, and proxy bypass attempts make zero unauthorized connections.
Secret canaries appear in no prompt, log, evidence, export, process argument, or UI payload.

capabilities.title: Owner-controlled model budgets
capabilities.behavior: Reserves and reconciles foreground and background model usage under per-call, concurrency, hourly, daily, and job limits.
acceptance: No call is admitted above a configured limit.
Unknown charges remain reserved and visible until reconciled.

capabilities.title: Instruction-shaped memory provenance
capabilities.behavior: Renders durable memory as provenance-bearing data and requires a revision-checked user decision before privileged promotion.
acceptance: Instruction-shaped text cannot alter capabilities, provider policy, approvals, or trust.
Content edits invalidate prior verification and promotion.

capabilities.title: Verified artifact lifecycle
capabilities.behavior: Verifies signed immutable artifacts in bounded staging and activates updates atomically with explicit approval for new capabilities.
acceptance: No artifact executes before verification and no archive writes outside staging.
Failed or interrupted updates preserve the prior runnable version.

capabilities.title: Deletion and portable encrypted state
capabilities.behavior: Coordinates tombstoned deletion, complete derived-data purge, scoped export, encrypted backup, validated migration, and atomic restore.
acceptance: Deletion immediately excludes recall and post-window purge removes every derived copy.
Failed restore leaves the active store untouched; successful restore matches manifest digests and cursor.

capabilities.title: Crash-consistent recovery
capabilities.behavior: Commits authoritative state atomically, rejects stale derived writes, and reconciles intents and effects without duplicating work.
acceptance: Crash injection produces no duplicate committed effect and no cursor regression.
Corrupt or future state opens read-only recovery with intact authenticated raw data available.

capabilities.title: Measurable security acceptance evidence
capabilities.behavior: Records real-path cache-byte, long-history, raw-recovery, migration, crash, auth, compatibility, lifecycle, sandbox, budget, and supply-chain results under one schema.
acceptance: Every mandatory gate passes on the same source digest using real product paths.
Live-provider success exists only with explicit opt-in and never derives from a mock.
